parameters.name: AddressGroups
parameters.description: The application address groups. Required when ConfigMode is set to Precise. Not allowed when ConfigMode is an empty string.

parameters.name: Addresses
parameters.description: The collection of internal-facing access application addresses. You can specify up to 1000 addresses.

parameters.name: BrowserAccessStatus
parameters.description:
The browser access status of the internal-facing access application. After this feature is enabled, you can access internal applications in a clientless manner. Default value: **Disabled**. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

parameters.name: ConfigMode
parameters.description:
The configuration mode. Valid values:
* Empty string: default mode.
* Precise: precise mode.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the internal-facing access application. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: L7Config
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the application configuration.

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the prefix of the mapped proxy domain name. The prefix must be 3 to 20 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainCustom
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter: the custom proxy domain name. The value must be a valid domain name.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the internal-facing access application. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: PortRanges
parameters.description: The collection of port ranges for the internal-facing access application. You can specify up to 65535 port ranges. Port ranges cannot overlap or be duplicated.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **All**: all protocols.
- **TCP**
- **UDP**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The collection of internal-facing access tag IDs. You can associate up to 6 custom-type internal-facing access tags with each application.
